question: The population of a district is 385000, out of which 168000 are males. 52% of the population is literate. If 21% males are literate, then what percentage of females are literate?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total population = 385,000, Males = 168,000 ⇒ Females = 217,000

Ratio of Male to Female = 168,000 : 217,000 = 24 : 31

Using the Alligation method on literacy rates:

(Female % − 52%) ÷ (52% − 21%) = Male Ratio ÷ Female Ratio = 24 ÷ 31

⇒ (Female % − 52%) ÷ 31% = 24 ÷ 31 ⇒ Female % − 52% = 24% ⇒ Female % = 76%

**∴ The correct answer is 76%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total population = 385,000

Total males = 168,000

Overall literate population = 52%

Male literate population = 21%
